verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agentic-commerce product API, so post-purchase order status and tracking is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack only covers product search, lookup, affiliate sale attribution (channel3-docs-4, channel3-docs-19) and product price-tracking webhooks (channel3-docs-16). None of it shows an endpoint, MCP tool or CLI command for querying the status or shipment tracking of a placed order. Purchases appear to complete through retailer buy URLs.
